name: read_card
description: Read a card by id: state, project, parents, teams, assignments, role efforts, custom fields, tags, description.

name: read_search
description: Find cards by name text or #id, type, state, project, assignee and tag; open cards only unless includeClosed.

text.description: Text in the card name, or a #id (bare digits match the id and the name)

type.description: Entity type, e.g. UserStory, Task, Bug, Feature (default: any assignable card)

assignee.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

name: read_my_work
description: Cards assigned to the current user (the token owner), open ones by default, with counts per state.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. Task or Bug (default: any assignable card)

name: read_states
description: States of a card's own workflow, or of a type in a project; team workflow states are flagged isTeamWorkflow.

type.description: Entity type (when no card id), e.g. UserStory

name: read_people
description: Find people by name, login or email (every word must match); without a query, everyone active.

name: read_teams
description: List teams (active by default), optionally filtered by name.

name: read_roles
description: List roles; hasEffort tells whether a role can carry effort.

name: read_projects
description: List projects (active by default) with abbreviation and process.

name: read_releases
description: Releases, newest first, optionally for one project.

name: read_iterations
description: Team or project iterations (sprints), newest first; without team or project, every team's current ones.

name: read_custom_field_options
description: Custom fields of a card's type, or of a type in a project, with the allowed dropdown values.

name: read_comments
description: Comments on a card as plain text, oldest first, with author and reply parent.

name: read_relations
description: Relations of a card in both directions, with the related card.

name: read_times
description: Time logged on a card or by a person, optionally between dates, with the total spent.

name: read_attachments
description: Attachments of a card with name, size, owner, date and URL. URLs need Basic or cookie auth, not the token.

name: read_test_plan
description: A test plan with its test cases and ordered steps, child test plans, and recent runs.

runs.description: How many recent runs to include (default 10)

name: write_create_card
description: Create a card under its parent, inheriting the project; replaces default assignees with the requested ones, reports parent changes.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. UserStory, Task, Bug

parent.description: Parent card id (story for a task, feature for a story, test plan for a test case, ...)

project.description: Project; defaults to the parent's project

format.description: Default: text, or html when it is HTML; Markdown needs markdown

teams.description: Teams to assign; TP_DEFAULT_TEAM_ID applies when omitted

user.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

role.description: Role name or id, e.g. "Developer", "Product Owner"
Role name or id, e.g. "Developer", "Product Owner"

fields.description: Any other settable fields as Targetprocess JSON, validated against the catalog

name: write_update_card
description: Update a card's name, description, tags, release, iteration, parent or other fields; changes are read back.

format.description: Default: text, or html when it is HTML; Markdown needs markdown

tags.description: Replaces the whole list; use addTags/removeTags to edit it

parent.description: New parent card; for a test case, a test plan to ADD it to (existing plans are kept)

fields.description: Other settable fields; state, people, effort, teams and custom fields have their own tools

name: write_set_state
description: Move a card, or one team's state on it, to a state by name or id; reports the parent card's state change.

state.description: State name or id, e.g. "In Progress", "Coded"

team.description: Team whose team state to set

name: write_assign
description: Assign a person to a card in a role, adding to existing assignments; reads the assignments back.

user.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

role.description: Role name or id, e.g. "Developer", "Product Owner"

exclusive.description: Also remove everyone else in this role; only when explicitly asked

name: write_unassign
description: Remove one person's assignment from a card; role is required when they hold several.

user.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

role.description: Role name or id, e.g. "Developer", "Product Owner"

name: write_set_role_effort
description: Set effort per role on a card (never the card total). A task's efforts roll up into its story; both are reported.

role.description: Role name or id, e.g. "Developer", "Product Owner"

name: write_set_custom_fields
description: Set custom fields by name, e.g. {"BackEnd":"Done"}; dropdown values are validated first, null clears.

name: write_team
description: Add or remove teams on a card (names or ids).

name: write_comment
description: Add a comment to a card, or reply to one with replyTo.

format.description: Default: text, or html when it is HTML; Markdown needs markdown

name: write_log_time
description: Log time spent on a card for a person (default: you, today). Creates a Time entry or a time record, as the process tracks it.

remain.description: Remaining time to record on the card

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the server's time zone

role.description: Defaults to the person's only role on the card; required when they have none or several

user.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

name: write_relate
description: Relate two cards (Relation by default; Dependency, Blocker, Link, Duplicate, ...). An identical relation is left alone.

direction.description: outbound (default): id is the master of to; inbound: to is the master

name: write_follow
description: Follow (or with unfollow: true, stop following) a card, for yourself or another person.

user.description: Person name, login, email, id, or "me"

name: write_test_cases
description: Create test cases with ordered steps under a test plan; each case is read back.

name: write_test_run
description: Record a run of a test plan, with a result per test case (Passed, Failed, Blocked, OnHold, NotRun).

name: delete_card
description: Delete a card by id; reports what was deleted and the parent card's state and efforts before/after.

withChildren.description: Required for a card with child cards (a story's tasks and bugs, a feature's stories, ...): they may be deleted too

name: delete_relation
description: Delete the relation between two cards, in either direction.

relation.description: Relation type name, when the cards have several

name: read_history
description: Change history of an entity, oldest first: state, effort, release, iteration; full: true for every field change.

resource.description: Omit for cards; needed for other entities, e.g. Comment

name: write_attachment
description: Upload base64-encoded files to a card and read them back; pounce never reads local files.

name: read_meta
description: Describe this instance's resources, or one resource's fields and collections. Use it before other raw tools.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: read_get
description: Get one entity of any resource by id (raw). Prefer read_card for cards.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: read_query
description: Query any resource with where/include/orderBy (raw), fully paged. Use include to keep results small.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

where.description: v1 filter, e.g. (EntityState.Name eq 'Open') and (Project.Id eq 2). Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, in; no 'or'.

name: read_collection
description: Get an inner collection of an entity, e.g. UserStories/{id}/Tasks (raw), fully paged.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

collection.description: Collection name, e.g. Tasks, Comments, Assignments

where.description: v1 filter, e.g. (EntityState.Name eq 'Open') and (Project.Id eq 2). Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, in; no 'or'.

name: write_create
description: Create an entity of any resource (raw), validated against the catalog. Prefer write_create_card for cards.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

fields.description: Targetprocess JSON without Id, e.g. {"Name":"x","Project":{"Id":2}}; children nest as {"Tasks":{"Items":[...]}}; custom fields as "CustomFields":[{"Name","Value"}]

name: write_update
description: Update fields of any entity (raw), validated and read back. Card effort: use write_set_role_effort.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

fields.description: Entity fields as Targetprocess JSON, e.g. {"Name":"x","Project":{"Id":2}}

name: write_bulk
description: Create or update up to 500 entities of one resource (raw); items with "Id" update. Nothing is sent if one is invalid.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: write_collection_add
description: Append items to a collection of any entity (raw); nothing is replaced.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

collection.description: Collection name from read_meta, e.g. Assignments, TagObjects, Builds

items.description: Items to add, e.g. [{"GeneralUser":{"Id":1},"Role":{"Id":13}}] or [{"Id":42}] to link an existing entity

name: delete_entity
description: Delete one entity of any resource (raw); reports what was deleted.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: delete_bulk
description: Delete up to 500 entities of one resource by id (raw).

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: delete_collection_remove
description: Remove items from a collection of any entity by child id (raw), e.g. unlink test cases from a test plan.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

collection.description: Collection name from read_meta, e.g. Assignments, TagObjects, Builds

name: read_v2_query
description: Targetprocess v2 query (raw): select, where with and/or, aggregations. v2 omits null fields: absence means null.

name: read_context
description: Targetprocess Context for entities, projects or teams: processes, practices, terms, custom field definitions.

name: read_conversions
description: Type conversions of a card: its current id if it was converted, and the ids it was converted from.

name: read_deleted
description: Deleted projects or users, with their delete date (restore: admin_undelete).

name: read_storage
description: RESTful storage (views, boards, settings): list groups, a group's storages, or one storage by group and key.

name: write_storage
description: Create or merge a storage entry: posted keys are set, other keys kept, null deletes a key. Owner or admin only.

key.description: Omit to let Targetprocess generate one

name: delete_storage
description: Delete one storage entry (owner or admin only).

name: admin_create
description: Create an administration entity (Project, Team, User, Process, Workflow, Role, CustomField, ...); needs an administrator token.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

fields.description: Entity fields as Targetprocess JSON, e.g. {"Name":"x","Project":{"Id":2}}

name: admin_update
description: Update an administration entity (Project, Team, User, Process, Workflow, Role, CustomField, ...); needs an administrator token.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

fields.description: Entity fields as Targetprocess JSON, e.g. {"Name":"x","Project":{"Id":2}}

name: admin_delete
description: Delete an administration entity (Project, Team, User, Process, Workflow, Role, CustomField, ...); needs an administrator token.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

name: admin_collection_add
description: Add items to a collection of an administration entity, e.g. Team TeamMembers (Project, Team, User, Process, Workflow, Role, CustomField, ...); needs an administrator token.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

collection.description: Collection name from read_meta, e.g. Assignments, TagObjects, Builds

items.description: Items to add, e.g. [{"GeneralUser":{"Id":1},"Role":{"Id":13}}] or [{"Id":42}] to link an existing entity

name: admin_collection_remove
description: Remove items from a collection of an administration entity (Project, Team, User, Process, Workflow, Role, CustomField, ...); needs an administrator token.

resource.description: Resource name (UserStory) or plural path (UserStories); see read_meta

collection.description: Collection name from read_meta, e.g. Assignments, TagObjects, Builds

name: admin_undelete
description: Restore deleted entities by id and entity type; needs an administrator token. Comments cannot be undeleted.
